current_answer: First, I store each array element along with its original index, so sorting does not make me lose track of the required indices. Next, I sort these elements by value and initialize two pointers: one at the beginning and one at the end of the array. I calculate the sum of the two pointed values. If the sum equals the target, I return their original indices. If the sum is smaller than the target, I move the left pointer one step to the right to increase the sum. If the sum is larger, I move the right pointer one step to the left to decrease the sum. I repeat this process until I find a matching pair or the pointers meet. If they meet without finding a match, I return that no valid pair exists.
